_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that connects consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments in more than 200 countries and territories to fast, secure and reliable electronic payments.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'Intense competition in our industry may cause our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects for future growth to suffer.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that connects consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments in more than 200 countries and territories to fast, secure and reliable electronic payments.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'Intense competition in our industry may cause our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects for future growth to suffer.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.29x; +75% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.28; conservative 2yr -7%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.2%/yr (FY14 revenue guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.6-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +25.1%/yr (FY09-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY13, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2014-04-25) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.29x (42.0% downside to Bear $115.37 / +32.6% upside to Bull $263.74) | Adj composite 1.84 vs market 3.12: gap -1.28 [OVERVALUED] | +75% above the EPP floor $113.85 (15x FY14E $7.59) | Conservative 2-yr case: -7.1% total (-3.5%/yr) | At 26.2x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $263.08 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +6.9% YoY in Q2 FY14, forward revenues +10-11% (FY14 net revenue growth guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
